question: On exact released before/after-checkpoint packed tokens, what evidence does probability-weighted Min-K++ add over likelihood, and do normalization-definition or arithmetic variants materially change the result?

split.selection: Hash-sort component identity within official arm; first1000 dev, next1000 test; all assignments sealed before scoring.

scoring.model_scoring_subset: All2000 test records plus1000 dev nonmembers. Dev members are used only by the text-only baseline, not target-model scoring.
scoring.attention_mask: all_ones; preserve original packed training context including token0 if present
scoring.pandora_comparator_scope: Same-forward normalization/reduction only, not literal historical pipeline replication; pinned helper forwards2049 IDs and defaults attention mask to input_ids>0.
scoring.cpu_float64_diagnostic: First two dev nonmembers only; conditional on same returned model logits, not CPU model-forward parity.
scoring.invalid_support: Preserve failed output and attempted denominator; stop and diagnose, no silent token or record dropping.

analysis.auc_uncertainty: 3000 paired within-arm bootstrap draws, seed20261107; conditional on fixed released bank, no family-generalization claim.
analysis.tail_threshold: Dev nonmembers only: p=(1+number(dev_score>=test_score))/(1000+1); flag p<=0.01, ties included conservatively.
analysis.blind_baseline: Char3-5 TFIDF(max_features20000,sublinear_tf=True,lowercase=True)+LogisticRegression(C1,solverliblinear,class_weightbalanced,max_iter1000,seed20261107), fit dev only; no test tuning.

interpretation.paper_reproduction: New pinned-data implementation/definition comparison, not exact reproduction of historical CheckMIABench tables.
interpretation.stop_or_reconsider: If weighted Min-K++ has no useful advantage over likelihood, or differences are explained by arithmetic or text-only labels, remove superiority language and change the research question. Do not tune and re-use the same test bank as fresh validation.
